claims.text: DBOS is a library whose only dependency is Postgres; it checkpoints each step and resumes workflows from the last completed step.
DBOS requires workflow functions to be deterministic and steps to be idempotent.
DBOS estimates about 1,000 workflows or steps per second per Postgres vCPU.
Temporal's Agent Harness, announced Aug 20 2026, makes every agent a Temporal Workflow.
Temporal's Agent Harness inserts a policy seam that can pause execution for human approval.
Temporal describes the Agent Harness as earlier than public preview.
The OpenAI Agents SDK integration with Temporal's Python SDK became generally available on March 23 2026.
Ramp's Inspect background coding agent runs in Modal sandboxes whose full-stack environment includes Temporal.
